question: How much present-state uncertainty is attributable to imperfect measurement, incomplete spatial coverage, or distinctions that complete perfect source tags cannot resolve?

unchanged_design.generator: v23/v41 original generator, all 768 designs including empty non-source graphs
unchanged_design.baseline: exact non-source occupancy at original t=4,5,6,8
unchanged_design.prior: uniform over the same three activation histories
unchanged_design.selected_sites: unchanged v39 prepare_design selections, up to three sites; actual selected count reported

noisy_assay.likelihood: unchanged v41 target_bayes_information; ideal first-arrival tags, not genetic ancestry

unchanged_design.state_mappings: unchanged v26 process maps and common Tstar; no new lag or process

nested_evidence: O+P_selected: perfect complete observations of those same selected tags
O+P_all: perfect observations of every non-source tag

entropy_partition.interpretation: expected conditional entropy under the fixed candidate-model prior, not individual outcome uncertainty or causal variance partition

bayes_error_partition: Apply the same telescoping differences to expected optimal target misclassification error; do not compare raw accuracies of different targets as equivalent endpoints.

reporting.geometry: report clustered and dispersed separately; no treatment/causal interpretation
reporting.shares: ratio of summed component entropies to summed residual entropy, not mean of individual ratios; null where denominator is zero
reporting.dominance_rule: source-type-floor majority only when structural residual share > 0.5; otherwise report the largest component and do not relabel thresholds
per_design_classification: selected noisy tags fully determine target

mandatory_controls: All four entropy and Bayes-error components nonnegative within 1e-9 and sum to baseline within 1e-9.
Reproduce v41 baseline population counts and source-class residual counts 81/12/45/45.
Reproduce confluence history-information-positive 120, maturity-positive 48, history-only 72 on original 189 designs.
History-blind target has zero entropy and error at every stage.
Perfect-all entropy cannot exceed perfect-selected or noisy-selected expected entropy.
No source rows, policies or states dropped according to newly observed results.
